apps.name: PostgreSQL

params.label: 对外开放端口
params.warn: 数据库暴露在公网上有被扫描、爆破的风险,请确认防火墙和密码强度

apps.compose:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:${version}
    container_name: ${container}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ${limits}
    ports:
      - "${bind}${port}:5432"
    volumes:
      - ${container}-data:${data_dir}
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${env.password}
    labels:
      otter.managed: db
      otter.app: postgres
volumes:
  ${container}-data:

post.notes: 管理员密码只显示这一次,Otter 不保存

apps.name: Redis

params.label: 对外开放端口
params.warn: 数据库暴露在公网上有被扫描、爆破的风险,请确认防火墙和密码强度

apps.compose:
services:
  db:
    image: redis:${version}
    container_name: ${container}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ${limits}
    ports:
      - "${bind}${port}:6379"
    volumes:
      - ${container}-data:${data_dir}
    environment:
      REDIS_PASSWORD: ${env.password}
    command: ["sh", "-c", "exec redis-server --appendonly yes --requirepass \"$$REDIS_PASSWORD\""]
    labels:
      otter.managed: db
      otter.app: redis
volumes:
  ${container}-data:

apps.name: OpenResty
apps.summary: 反向代理、静态站点、HTTPS 证书;装好后在「网站」页管理站点

params.label: HTTP 端口
params.help: 容器用 host 网络,由 OpenResty 直接占用;默认站点监听它,新建站点也以它为默认端口。证书的 HTTP 验证需要公网能访问 80

apps.compose:
# managed by otter (layout 1)
services:
  openresty:
    image: openresty/openresty:${version}
    container_name: ${container}
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    ${limits}
    labels:
      otter.managed: websites
      otter.app: openresty
    volumes:
      - /opt/otter/websites/conf/nginx.conf:/usr/local/openresty/nginx/conf/nginx.conf:ro
      - /opt/otter/websites/conf/conf.d:/etc/nginx/conf.d:ro
      - /opt/otter/websites/certs:/etc/otter/certs:ro
      - /opt/otter/websites/sites:/www/sites:ro
      - /opt/otter/websites/acme-webroot:/www/acme:ro
      - /opt/otter/websites/logs:/var/log/nginx

apps.name: MinIO
apps.summary: 兼容 S3 的对象存储(API 9000,控制台 9001)

params.label: 对外开放端口
params.warn: 对象存储暴露在公网上有被扫描、爆破的风险,请确认防火墙和密码强度

apps.compose:
services:
  app:
    image: minio/minio:${version}
    container_name: ${container}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ${limits}
    command: ["server", "/data", "--console-address", ":9001"]
    ports:
      - "${bind}${api_port}:9000"
      - "${bind}${console_port}:9001"
    volumes:
      - ${container}-data:/data
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: "${user}"
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${env.password}
    labels:
      otter.managed: app
      otter.app: minio
volumes:
  ${container}-data:

post.notes: 控制台用上面的账号密码登录;密码只显示这一次
